description: Carhopp finds and compares rental cars at airports, train stations, and cities worldwide. Search live prices from major agencies and local suppliers, filter by category (economy, SUV, van, premium), transmission, price, and free cancellation, then check rental conditions and continue to the provider's secure booking page. Ask things like "rent a car in Barcelona next weekend" or "cheap automatic SUV at CDG airport".
